name: Balance Tail
flavor_text: A marvel of cybernetics designed to redefine spatial awareness. This dynamically calibrated tail provides unparalleled micro-adjustments, facilitating advanced traversal and mitigating instability in volatile environments. Its integrated gyroscopic stabilizers offer predictive balance correction, minimizing any risk during rapid maneuvers.
effect: A mechanical, gyroscopic tail is added to the user. It grants +20 to all tests to prevent falling over and other tests relying on balance.
mods: Cheap, Integrated Weaponry, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: Double Arm
flavor_text: Featuring fully articulated, bio-integrated appendages, the @market_name@ dramatically expands dexterity and manipulation capabilities. Independent analysis reveals an astounding 37% increase in simultaneous task completion rates, even after accounting for reduced focus per task.
effect: This arm can split into two arms with 3 digits each. This grants an additional action if it can be performed simultaneously; when doing so, these actions suffer an additional -10 penalty.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Integrated Weaponry

name: Mechanical Tail
flavor_text: A bio-engineered appendage designed for decisive action. The hardened carbon fiber weave, coupled with micro-conductive filaments, generates focused kinetic energy bursts upon impact. It offers unparalleled targeting accuracy and delivers a debilitating disruptive force.
effect: The user gains an articulated mechanical tail, which allows for a new combat action: Tail Attack - an unarmed attack with the \emph{Flexible} special rule. If it hits, the target also suffers a -D5 to his Initiative.
mods: Cheap, Integrated Weaponry, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: Mechanical Tendrils
flavor_text: Utilizing the most advanced neural interfacing, @market_name@ grants you unparalleled spatial control. Each tail is equipped with pressure sensors and top-of-the-line piezo-actuators allowing for rapid area denial. Imagine: creating defensive barriers, disorienting opponents, or even delivering precise strikes from unexpected angles.
effect: Adds a additional combat action each round - which may be either an unarmed attack with the Flexible quality, or a Parry. This action suffers a -20 penalty, as if turned. \\ This implant can be taken once per size category (e.g. 4 for average humans, 3 for small, 6 for huge characters), without requiring an additional implant location (only additional load).
mods: Cheap, Integrated Weaponry, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: Mind Screws
flavor_text: When measuring performance gains through quantifiable metrics, users demonstrate an average 78% increase in tactical processing speed and a 65% boost to reactive aggression levels. Combat effectiveness is demonstrably elevated; strategic decision-making surpasses instinct.
effect: While \emph{Frenzied} the user has +10 Courage and Strength. Tests to resist or end \emph{Frenzy} suffer a -40 penalty.

name: Shield Arms
flavor_text: The @market_name@ offers unparalleled tactical advantage through bio-integrated augmentation. Featuring unique exo-skeletal extensions, this system dramatically enhances defensive capabilities
slogan: A strategic investment in optimized efficiency.
effect: Adds 2 additional arms holding reactive armor plates. They each grant an additional parry action against either melee or (even non-primitive) ranged attacks when taking a defensive stance.
mods: Cheap, Integrated Weaponry, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted

name: Wings of Light
flavor_text: We've harnessed resonant frequency modulation to optimize neurological processing speed. While we refrain from definitively confirming temporal dilation, user reports consistently demonstrate vastly heightened situational awareness and immensely accelerated reaction times.
effect: On use (as a free action during declaration) this grants an additional action and doubles both MS and Initiative for one combat round. While this is active, the character can dodge or parry non-primitive ranged weapons. Each use causes D10-(unused RI) exhaustion. May be used each combat round.

name: Deflector Skin
flavor_text: This isn't merely plating; it's a dynamically adaptive defense system. Utilizing micro-scale meta-armor made from bio-responsive polymers, our @market_name@ analyzes incoming threats in milliseconds and generates localized counter-forces - redirecting kinetic energy, absorbing thermal radiation, and dispersing projectile impacts with astonishing efficiency.
slogan: The best in armor, at your command.
effect: When taking a defensive stance, the user may make a Constitution test as a free action to reduce the damage of an incoming hit by its DoS. The user takes a level of exhaustion per hit taken.

name: Fire Breath
flavor_text: We acknowledge the allure of draconic capabilities. The @market_name@ utilizes stabilized plasma containment and neural dampeners to mitigate risk. Subjective reports indicate an exhilarating sensation - a primal connection to elemental power. Inquiries regarding risk mitigation strategies can be directed to [Redacted - Requires Level 2 Thermo Certification].
effect: The user gains access to the following weapon profile twice per day: \begin{sitemize} \item Shots: 3 \item Damage: 1D10+2 \item Range: 4m \item Flame, Scatter, Spray \end{sitemize} It uses Ranged Combat Training (Integrated Weaponry).

name: Smoke Vents
flavor_text: These micro-engineered vents utilize compressed atmospheric particles and bioluminescent dyes to generate dense, multi-spectrum smokescreens - capable of completely concealing movement and disrupting sensor arrays.
effect: The character may cause a Blast (3), Smoke effect around himself. It takes about 12 hours to recharge.

name: Tail Spike
flavor_text: The @market_name@ isn't mere ornamentation; it's a dynamically articulated defensive and offensive weapon system. Each spine is composed of self-sharpening biocomposite material, capable of inflicting significant puncture wounds or delivering debilitating kinetic impact.
effect: The character gains a stinger. This allows a new combat action: Tail Attack (unarmed attack with the \emph{Piercing} and \emph{Flexible} special rules). If the character also has \emph{Venom Sacs}, the attack applies this toxin.
mods: Cheap, Integrated Weaponry, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: Vampirism
flavor_text: Ideal to improve metabolic efficiency in times of scarcity - @market_name@ allows for the extraction of trace organic compounds from ambient sources, primarily blood and decaying matter, converting them into vital energy reserves. There is no compromising on survival.
effect: The user may drink untreated blood to substitute water and food consumption. Poison and extremely heavy pollutants may still cause poisoning.

name: Venom Sacs
flavor_text: The @market_name@'s deployment requires stringent regulatory oversight and specialized training. Initial development focused on optimizing venom synthesis and delivery for targeted toxin production - a critical component in certain chemical manufacturing processes. While predominantly utilized within specialized chemical production facilities-designated as 'Chem Farms', the Venom Sac implant is increasingly available for broader applications.
effect: Produces and stores one type of chemical. Which chemicals are available is up to the GM. \\ It produces one dose per week and stores up to 3 at a time. If more are produced than can be stored, the user suffers its effects, detriments and overdose effects.
mods: Integrated Weaponry (only ranged weapons with Spray rule), Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted
